incident-bot: [P1] Runtime OOM + paging detected on prod-inference-rs-23 at 2024-11-05T12:00:10Z. Error spike on /v1/embeddings. Pager triggered to @sam_oncall.

sam_oncall: I’m on it. Can someone grab nvidia-smi + kernel logs from the node?

maria_eng: pulling logs now — posting the tail from runtime↓

maria_eng: ```
E 12:00:06 runtime: allocation failed: requested 512MB, available 24MB -> OOM
W 12:00:07 kvcache: insert failed, current_entries=1.2M, capacity=1.25M
I 12:00:08 pager: node paged to host swap at 12:00:07
```

ben: quick datapoint from metrics: embeddings 95p latency jumped 3.2s -> 7.8s at 12:00. Error rate +3.5% for the cluster.

carla_sre: nvidia-smi snapshot (12:00:09): GPU0 24GB total, used 23.6GB, processes: runtime pid=4121 (python) mem=23.4GB. Swap usage on host ~8GB.

dmitri_ml: hypothesis 1: KV cache growth not evicting properly -> high memory pressure + fragmentation. Hypothesis 2: batching spike (large batch) requested huge KV rows causing allocations to fail and trigger paging.

sam_oncall: action list: 1) reduce batch size on embeddings route to 8 (canary), 2) force aggressive KV eviction policy, 3) collect pmap/pid maps and allocator stats. Ben, can you deploy the batch change?

ben: started canary: reduced batch_size from 32 -> 8 on 10% of traffic at 12:03 UTC. Rolling config: `service.embeddings.batch_size=8`. Monitoring now.

maria_eng: collected allocator snapshot and pmap for pid 4121 — attaching excerpt:

maria_eng: ```
12:04:11 pid=4121 pmap: total 24G, mapped anon 22.8G, rss 22.6G
malloc_stats: arenas=12, fragmentation_ratio=1.18, free_chunks=94MB
kv_cache.entries=1,214,567, avg_value_size=5.1KB
```

carla_sre: changed kvcache eviction from LRU->aggressive at 12:05 (runtime flag: `--kvcache-evict-threshold=0.75`). Watching eviction rate.

sre-logger-bot: eviction events (12:05-12:09): 42k entries evicted, reclaimed ~210MB.

ben: canary looks promising: error rate on canary pods down to baseline within 30s. No new OOMs reported on canary.

dmitri_ml: if canary is good, schedule reducing global batch immediately; but we should also capture fragmentation pattern — many small allocations -> fragmentation. Requesting jemalloc stats (/jemalloc/stats) from runtimes.

sam_oncall: collected jemalloc: `active=23.1G, allocated=21.9G, retained=1.2G, dirty_pages=3400`. Fragmentation shows retained > 1GB.

maria_eng: timeline so far:
- 12:00:06 first OOM allocation failure reported by runtime
- 12:00:07 host swap engaged, tail latency spike begins
- 12:03:00 canary batch-size reduced to 8 (10% traffic)
- 12:05:30 KV eviction policy set to aggressive on implicated nodes
- 12:06:00 error rate begins to decline on canary; 12:08:00 cluster-wide metrics improving

carla_sre: customer impact: two mid-market customers saw 4% request failures for ~8min window. No broader data loss. CS informed at 12:15.

ops-pager: paging still observed on 1 node (r-23-gpu-07) but no new OOMs since 12:06. Host swap I/O back to normal by 12:12.

ben: rolled batch_size=8 to 100% at 12:10 after canary pass. Monitoring looks stable.

maria_eng: gathering full heap profiles (tcmalloc/jemalloc) from 3 affected pods and uploading to /incidents/1729453210/artifacts. Link: https://redwood.internal/ARTIFACTS/1729453210

dmitri_ml: early analysis of heap: hot path allocations from `kv_cache::insert` and `tokenizer::batch_encode` showing spikes in avg allocation size per request when long-context prompts used. Suggest: 1) short-term: keep batch_size=8, 2) medium-term: patch kvcache to fence large prefix entries (>64KB) and cap per-request kvcache growth, 3) long-term: multi-arena allocator tuning and proactive defragmentation.

sam_oncall: handing off active pager to ben at 12:30 UTC for RCA writeup and follow-ups. Ben, please include timeline + artifacts + mitigation recommendations.

ben: acknowledged, taking over. I’ll start an RCA doc draft and ping for review. Next actions assigned:
- ben: draft RCA + mitigation (due 2024-11-06 09:00 PT)
- dmitri_ml: prototype kvcache guardrail PR (size cap)
- carla_sre: propose autoscale/eviction SLOs and postmortem customer blurb
- maria_eng: attach full logs & jemalloc dumps to artifacts link

sam_oncall: closing pager, marking incident as mitigated at 12:18 UTC. Will re-open if new OOMs appear. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident P1 mitigated — follow-up RCA required. Tags: kvcache, fragmentation, paging, runtime-oom.

ben: thanks everyone — creating RCA thread and will @-mention owners in the doc.
